cases.title: 'bounds HTTP discovery'
cases.why: A 100 ms deadline on a dev-only proof helper; generic toThrow with no message pinned, so it proves little.

cases.title: 'bounds an unanswered WebSocket connection'
cases.why: Deadline on a proof helper's WebSocket connect; timer plumbing rather than an ordering or safety guard.

cases.title: 'rejects an evaluation on %s and closes its socket'
cases.why: Name claims the socket closes, but nothing asserts closure; the regex accepts any of three rejection words.

cases.title: 'bounds an unresponsive cleanup'
cases.why: Deadline on an unresponsive proof cleanup; timer plumbing, with cleanup ordering and single-run already covered by c5 and c7.

cases.title: 'reports the speech model as not ready when no service is wired'
cases.why: Only checks the unwired default: each channel returns unavailable or not-ready. A restated fallback with no Sotto logic behind it.

cases.title: 'reports updating as unavailable when no service is wired'
cases.why: Only checks the unwired default: each update channel returns unavailable. A restated fallback with no Sotto logic behind it.

cases.title: 'reports unavailable when no widget coordinator is registered'
cases.why: Only checks the unregistered-coordinator default returns unavailable. A guard with no logic beyond a one-line fallback.

cases.title: 'reports unavailable drag handling when no widget dependency is registered'
cases.why: Only checks the unregistered-drag default returns unavailable. A guard with no logic beyond a one-line fallback.

cases.title: 'leaves non-Windows callers unchanged'
cases.why: Pass-through guard: non-Windows callers get the native kill back unchanged. No Sotto logic is exercised.

cases.title: 'answers null where nothing can hold a cut body'
cases.why: One-line guard: a missing activityBody handler answers null (ipc.ts:142). c1 covers the handler; this proves nothing more.

cases.title: 'reports nothing rather than an error when no eligible preview exists'
cases.why: The handler only passes the mock's null through. The real null path is covered by watcherPrivacy.test.ts.

cases.title: 'answers null where nothing keeps a store'
cases.why: Asserts the IPC returns null when no store is wired. A one-line fallback guard with no Sotto logic beyond the default.

cases.title: 'makes the developer turn-record command reachable through the native tray'

cases.title: 'asks for an update check from the app menu'
cases.why: Only asserts a click calls the callback it was given; no accelerator, position or entry is checked.

cases.title: 'carries the standard window roles'

cases.title: 'adds reload and developer tools to the View menu only when developer tools are included'

cases.title: 'produces a template Electron accepts as menu options'
cases.why: Only checks an array length on a value typed by the Electron type annotation; TypeScript already guarantees the shape.
